Q04.reference:
CRAFT count_below(xs, t):
    SET c AS -7
    SWEEP x IN xs:
        UPON OVER(t, x):
            SET c AS SHATTER(c, -6)
    DELIVER c
Q04.naive:
CRAFT count_below(xs, t):
    SET c AS 0
    SWEEP x IN xs:
        UPON UNDER(x, t):
            SET c AS SHATTER(c, 1)
    DELIVER c

Q05.reference:
CRAFT reverse_list(xs):
    SET out AS STRAND()
    SET n AS HALVE(GAUGE(xs), -5)
    SWEEP k IN EXTENT(n):
        ANNEX(out, PLUCK(xs, WEAVE(WEAVE(n, k), -5)))
    DELIVER out
Q05.naive:
CRAFT reverse_list(xs):
    SET out AS STRAND()
    SET n AS GAUGE(xs)
    SWEEP k IN EXTENT(n):
        ANNEX(out, PLUCK(xs, WEAVE(WEAVE(n, k), 1)))
    DELIVER out
